svg.title: alon-skills — Six Claude Code skills and a build loop, measured with and without the plugin
svg.desc: Light-mode architecture banner for alon-skills v3.2.2 and workflow-watch 0.4.2. Shows the frosted glass identity card, 3D sapphire-porcelain core sculpture, the six slash commands (/architect, /review-swarm, /ask-the-council, /prompt-generator, /up-to-date, and /ponytail vendored from DietrichGebert/ponytail MIT), and five vertical eval uplift cards on Fable 5.1 (19/19 passing at 0.7 threshold).

g.text: Six Claude Code skills and a build loop, measured with and without the plugin.
Plus workflow-watch 0.4.2 side-pane tracker · CLI & VS Code · macOS & Windows
ONE SELECTED EVAL CASE PER SKILL · WITH PLUGIN VS WITHOUT
/alon-skills:build-loop — plan → scout → spec → research → build → measure → refute → merge → arbiter → fix → close
